# Authenticate every saved-login OS-auth setting change and restore state on cancel

The saved-login OS-auth checkbox calls OSKeyStore.ensureLoggedIn with force=false every time the setting changes. If authentication fails or the user cancels, _toggleOSAuth reverses the checkbox state and leaves the LoginHelper setting alone. Only an authenticated change calls LoginHelper.setOSAuthEnabled. The code deliberately uses ensureLoggedIn rather than LoginHelper.verifyOSAuth for each setting change. Current code retains the flow, though LoginHelper no longer takes the named pref argument. Treat the checkbox and stored setting as one transaction so a cancelled prompt does not leave a false UI state.

Scope: Saved logins and privacy.

Paths:

- `mail/components/preferences/privacy.js`
